# Tenon

> Tenon is a Go framework for building backend services. Business logic is written as actions; HTTP APIs, web pages (React, Mantine and TanStack Start), queue workers, scheduled jobs, CLI commands, MCP tools and RPC are entry points that call them. The application, front end included, compiles to a single binary.

The documentation is written in Chinese and organized by topic. Each link below is the Markdown source of one page on the main branch; read only the pages a task needs.

In a Tenon project, the documentation that matches the framework version in go.mod is in the Go module cache: `go list -m -f '{{.Dir}}' github.com/go-tenon/tenon` prints the directory, and the pages are in its docs directory.

Tenon 是用 Go 构建后端服务的框架。业务逻辑写成[业务动作](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/go-tenon/tenon/main/docs/concepts/actions.md)，HTTP 接口、网页、队列、定时任务、命令行、MCP 工具和 RPC 都是调用它的入口。框架直接使用社区组件：chi、Huma、slog、Bun、goose、Cobra，前端是 React、Mantine 和 TanStack Start。

文档按主题排列，每页一行。初学者的顺序：[安装](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/go-tenon/tenon/main/docs/installation/installing.md) → [入门教程](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/go-tenon/tenon/main/docs/tutorial/01-project.md) → [目录结构](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/go-tenon/tenon/main/docs/concepts/structure.md)、[业务动作](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/go-tenon/tenon/main/docs/concepts/actions.md)、[依赖装配](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/go-tenon/tenon/main/docs/concepts/dependencies.md) → 用到哪一部分读哪一页。

## 项目结构

- [目录结构](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/go-tenon/tenon/main/docs/concepts/structure.md)：目录、命名、框架包一览
- [业务动作](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/go-tenon/tenon/main/docs/concepts/actions.md)：一个用例一个类型，各入口调用它
- [依赖装配](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/go-tenon/tenon/main/docs/concepts/dependencies.md)：在入口创建依赖，传给业务代码
- [生命周期](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/go-tenon/tenon/main/docs/concepts/lifecycle.md)：启动、请求的处理、平滑停止、健康检查
